cards.title: Luminous Blue Whale
cards.subtitle: Public Submission · 公众投稿
cards.technique: AI Holographic Card · 一句话出卡
cards.collection: HoloLab 公众系列 · Public Series
cards.description:
[IDENTITY] Luminous Blue Whale · leviathan of the starry sea
[DESIGN]
Subject layer: a luminous blue whale soaring through clouds, bioluminescent cyan glow, centered, about 65% of canvas, crisp silhouette, rich detail.
Background layer: midnight ocean below with mirrored stars, strong depth, lower 40% stays empty for typography, no other figures.
Palette: deep sapphire and bioluminescent cyan, gilded warm accents, rainbow-foil gradient highlights, clear highlight and shadow separation.
Line art layer: glowing contour traced along the whale, even stroke width, black lines on white, glow spreading outward.
Typography layer: title "Leviathan of the Starlight Sea", subtitle "Mythic · Public Series", series number and rarity badge, gold outlined type.
cards.author: Elijah-Lin-Dancer
